label: Остановиться
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for остановиться (to stop, to come to a halt).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person, reflexive. 'Остановлюсь' is the 1sg of остановиться; the stem в takes an epenthetic л and the reflexive -сь is added. The imperfective partner is останавливаться.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Остановишься' shows the -ишь ending plus -ся; the л appears only in the 1sg, so it is absent here. 'На минуту' marks a brief halt.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 'Остановится' is the -ит form plus -ся of остановиться, naming a single halt. 'Через минуту' fixes the moment.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Остановимся' carries the -им ending plus -ся of остановиться, here meaning to stay somewhere. 'В этом отеле' names where.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Остановитесь' trains the -ите form plus -сь of остановиться. 'У нас' offers lodging in a natural invitation.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Остановятся' closes the person ladder with the -ят ending plus -ся of остановиться. 'На красный свет' names the cause.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Остановился' is the completed masculine past of остановиться, with -л before the reflexive -ся. 'Перед домом' fixes the spot.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Остановилась' adds the feminine -ла plus -сь of остановиться. The parallel 'обернулась' continues the completed past.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Остановились' is the plural -ли past plus -сь of остановиться. 'Ночью' marks when the clock stopped.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Остановись' is the command form of остановиться, keeping the reflexive -сь. 'Подумай немного' adds a second perfective command.
